name: Banned | 200mg Nerdless Gummies | Green Apple
description:
The same Banned products that you’ve come to know and love, are now NERDLESS! These gummies are meticulously crafted for flavor without compromising potency! Produced in iconic fruit flavors for an explosion of flavor on your tastebuds with a smooth, NERDLESS finish! These gummies are perfect for the budget-friendly consumer while never compromising quality, flavor, or potency! Experience the BANNED Effect today by ordering this delicious creation from BANNED Edible Co, a distinguished recipient of the High Times Cannabis Cup Award.

Effects: Precisely dosed at 50mg of THC in each gummy, the perfect dose to relax and send a user into a relaxing haze of bliss. These gummies are great for winding down and chilling out.
